learning_objective: 🎯 To blast off on a cosmic journey to understand the Sun, the Moon, the shiny stars, and our wonderful place in the giant universe!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Earth is not alone! We are part of a big space family called the Solar System. The Sun is the giant boss at the center, and Earth, along with seven other planets, travels around it in a path called an orbit.
The Moon does not have its own light; it shines like a mirror reflecting the Sun's light! As it travels around Earth, we see different lit-up shapes, which we call the phases of the moon.

Stars are giant balls of burning gas far, far away. Sometimes, groups of stars look like dot-to-dot pictures of animals or heroes in the night sky. These magical star patterns are called constellations!

fun_activity.title: 🔭 The Moon Watcher
fun_activity.instructions: Go outside tonight with a parent and look at the moon. Draw its exact shape in your notebook. Try looking again in 3 days to see how the shape has magically changed!

quick_recap: ⭐ The Solar System includes the Sun and eight planets orbiting around it.
⭐ The Moon revolves around the Earth, and its changing shapes are called phases.
⭐ Constellations are beautiful patterns formed by groups of stars in the night sky.
